interface.longDescription: Prepare an approximate global color look from an attached reference photo and reuse it across photos or short video clips. Adjust warmth, brightness, contrast, saturation and gamma. Compare photos and play videos inline. Clips must be MP4/MOV up to ten seconds and 50 MB. This is reference-inspired grading, not exact scene matching, color recovery or LUT export. Start using the tools without Firemoon account linking. An existing Firemoon account can optionally be connected to use its current entitlements.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a color look from this reference photo.
Apply this warm look to my photo and video.
